title: Riverfront Waste

items.label: Windblown Plastic
items.description: A plastic wrapper blows down the open riverbank toward the water.
items.visual_focus: a single plastic wrapper blowing toward the river water
items.local_cue: a wrapper at the sandy edge of the Padma River near Rajshahi

items.label: Uneven Steps
items.description: A visitor carries rubbish past worn riverside steps and keeps walking.
items.visual_focus: a visitor carefully sidestepping damaged riverside steps while holding litter
items.local_cue: the concrete steps of a Rajshahi Padma river ghat with a damaged edge

items.label: Leaving Bottles
items.description: A visitor leaves an empty water bottle on the sand while walking away.
items.visual_focus: a visitor walking away from an abandoned bottle on sand
items.local_cue: a discarded plastic bottle on the sandy Padma riverbank near a visitor

items.label: Food Cart Waste
items.description: A cart worker gathers used plates as the evening crowd moves away.
items.visual_focus: a food-cart worker gathering used plates into a bag
items.local_cue: a Bangladeshi riverside snack cart with paper plates near the Padma embankment

items.label: Full Riverside Bin
items.description: Visitors hold used cups beside a riverside bin already full of rubbish.
items.visual_focus: a riverside rubbish bin overflowing as visitors hold used cups
items.local_cue: a full waste bin beside the concrete Padma embankment walkway

items.label: Cleanup After Dark
items.description: A worker pulls a large bag of litter across the riverfront after visitors have left.
items.visual_focus: a lone worker hauling a large waste bag at dusk beside the river
items.local_cue: a worker carrying a waste sack up concrete steps from the Padma riverbank at dusk

questions: Which two scenes could send waste into the river?
What have you noticed about rubbish at a public gathering place in Rajshahi?
Should visitors carry waste away or should vendors collect it? Why?
Why might a busy food cart struggle to collect every used plate?
If more bins are placed by the water, what maintenance problem follows?
You have 250,000 BDT and 30 days. What one riverfront cleanup system would your grant test?

grant.pilot_scope: Trial a vendor-and-visitor collection system at one Padma riverfront gathering spot.

evidence.basis: supplied brief plus river pollution reporting
